name: Leigh-Anne Galloway
biography: Leigh-Anne Galloway is a Security Researcher who specializes in the areas of application and payment security. Leigh-Anne started her career in incident response, leading investigations into payment card data breaches. This is where she discovered her passion for security advisory and payment technologies. She has presented and authored research on ATM security, application security and payment technology vulnerabilities, and has previously spoken at DevSecCon, BSides, Hacktivity, 8dot8, OWASP, and Troopers. @L_AGalloway
